status_note: Reconciled against actual Windows checkout, clean-checkout verification and hosted CI on 2026-10-20. Foundation evidence only; later acceptance gates remain open.

tasks.title: Create the actual pnpm/Turborepo TypeScript workspace, with dashboard, widget, API and worker applications plus backend, UI, contracts, SDK, database, configuration, observability and testing packages.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: A fresh checkout installs with the committed lockfile and every application builds.

tasks.title: Implement feature-owned backend modules and frontend features; shared atomic UI components; explicit public module interfaces; import/dependency rules.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: CI rejects browser imports of server code, illegal cross-feature imports and circular dependencies.
tasks.remaining_work: Extend feature ownership and boundary enforcement as P02-P10 modules and frontend features are implemented.

tasks.title: Add supported pinned tooling, environment validation, .env.example, secret-safe .gitignore, formatting, linting and type checking.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Documented Windows setup works; no real credentials are in tracked files or build output.

tasks.title: Copy and maintain the blueprint, AGENTS.md, architecture decisions, feature map and contributor instructions in the source repository.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: A new developer can locate, run and change a feature using repository documentation.

tasks.title: Implement coherent changes as focused commits and push through an authorized write-capable environment without overwriting unrelated history.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Each delivered feature has a remote commit SHA and matching source files.
tasks.remaining_work: Keep subsequent feature delivery, remote verification and local runtime parity current through final handover.

tasks.title: Create the requested local Windows copy after real committed source exists.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Git history and HEAD match the remote at the requested path; the application runs there.
tasks.remaining_work: Keep subsequent feature delivery, remote verification and local runtime parity current through final handover.

tasks.title: Create versioned schemas and migrations for organizations, memberships, customers, conversations, messages, knowledge, integrations, jobs, audit records, subscriptions and usage.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Migrations rebuild an empty database and upgrade a previous release on a disposable environment.

tasks.title: Implement signup, verification, login/logout, recovery, staff invitations, role permissions and sensitive-session handling.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Positive and negative browser/API tests pass for owner, admin, agent, revoked and unauthenticated access.

tasks.title: Enforce tenant isolation in API authorization, SQL grants/RLS, storage, vector search, caches, queues, realtime delivery and exports.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: At least two tenants cannot read, alter or infer one another’s data through any tested path, including actual worker roles.

tasks.title: Encrypt integration credentials, keep privileged secrets server-side, validate configuration and document rotation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Browser output and logs are checked for secrets; permission and rotation tests pass.

tasks.title: Build installable responsive widget, scoped visitor sessions, message persistence, realtime delivery, reconnect and delivery/error states.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: A visitor communicates with the correct merchant from a real test website and reconnects without losing or duplicating messages.

tasks.title: Build merchant inbox, search, assignment, staff replies, internal notes, status management and notifications.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Staff complete a support case; internal notes never reach shoppers.

tasks.title: Implement AI/human conversation states with safe takeover during in-flight generation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Taking over while an AI reply is pending prevents that stale reply from being sent.

tasks.title: Build onboarding, workspace settings and accessible/mobile/error/empty/loading states.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: A pilot merchant can set up the widget and handle messages without database edits by a developer.

tasks.title: Implement safe file import, extraction, chunking, embeddings, tenant-scoped retrieval, source/version metadata and visible import errors.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Approved questions retrieve only the correct tenant’s sources; failed imports are visible.

tasks.title: Implement document replacement and removal across original files, index chunks, caches and applicable derived data.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Updated policies replace stale answers; deleted sources are no longer retrievable.

tasks.title: Implement replaceable model adapter, bounded tool calling, permission checks, timeouts, token/cost limits, circuit breakers and human fallback.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Live authorized model calls work; retries, outages and budget exhaustion fail safely.

tasks.title: Ground product and support answers in approved sources/live commerce tools; staff approval for refunds, discounts, cancellations and other configured sensitive actions.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Unsupported facts do not become invented prices, policies or orders; unauthorized actions are denied.

tasks.title: Build a versioned evaluation set for FAQs, ambiguity, unsupported requests, prompt injection, data leakage, tools and takeover.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Record results, failure cases, model/prompt version, latency and cost against pre-agreed release thresholds.

tasks.title: Choose and implement one authorized storefront integration behind a documented adapter, rather than several incomplete connectors.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Catalog, price, inventory and fulfillment information come from the real test store.

tasks.title: Implement credential lifecycle, least-privilege permissions, webhook verification, deduplication, synchronization/reconciliation and reconnect status.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Duplicate, delayed and out-of-order events do not corrupt state; expired access is visible.

tasks.title: Implement identity-verified private order lookup and legitimate checkout/cart links.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Knowing an order number alone is insufficient; checkout reflects the merchant’s actual products and prices.

tasks.title: Implement disconnect/uninstall and required merchant-data cleanup; satisfy the chosen distribution route’s requirements.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Revoked credentials stop jobs; cleanup is documented and tested.

tasks.title: Define plans, usage units, allowances, trial behavior, cancellations, refund policy, support coverage and tax/invoice handling with appropriate advice.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Published pricing and implemented entitlements agree; example invoices and edge cases are reviewed.

tasks.title: Implement the billing solution appropriate to the distribution route, checkout, customer portal, upgrades/downgrades, cancellation and failed-payment states.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: End-to-end subscription lifecycle is verified in the provider’s test environment; authorized live verification occurs before paid launch.

tasks.title: Verify webhook signatures, persist events durably, deduplicate and reconcile account state without assuming event order.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Replayed/out-of-order events do not grant incorrect access or double-count usage.

tasks.title: Implement per-tenant usage metering, concurrency-safe budget enforcement, overage approval/limits, spend alerts and a global AI kill switch.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Usage reconciles with provider records; the defined cap is enforced and human support remains available as designed.

tasks.title: Review threat model, access control, tenant leakage, session handling, sensitive routes, public-widget abuse, safe rendering, URL-import SSRF, uploads and dependencies.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Security findings are triaged and all launch-blocking issues resolved; relevant negative tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement data minimization, retention, export/deletion, privacy-safe logging, audit trails and controlled staff/operator access.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Document data flows and exercise export/deletion, including retrieval data and backup-retention limitations.

tasks.title: Review controller/processor roles, lawful basis, privacy notices, applicable processing agreements, subprocessors/transfers, cookie/storage choices and breach procedures.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Appropriate legal review is completed for the actual launch markets, use case and provider chain; no blanket compliance guarantee.

tasks.title: Implement clear AI interaction disclosure and assess applicable Article 50 content-marking obligations and other relevant AI requirements.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: The disclosure appears at the first interaction and the applicability/implementation review is recorded.

tasks.title: Prepare applicable commercial terms, business identification, customer-support contact and operating responsibilities.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Owner approves these for the actual business before onboarding paying customers.

tasks.title: Create separate staging/production configuration, projects, credentials and data; configure frontend, API, workers, database, storage, queues and email.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Each service is deployed and healthy; test/preview environments cannot access production customer data.

tasks.title: Configure domain/DNS/TLS, server secrets, email authentication, health/readiness checks and deployment manifests.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Customer journeys work through the intended domain and real email delivery.

tasks.title: Implement CI/CD gates, staged promotion, backward-compatible migrations, release versioning and rollback.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Release a known commit to staging then production; record checks and exercise application rollback.

tasks.title: Configure database and object-file backups; define acceptable data loss/recovery time and exercise restoration.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Restore data and required documents into a clean environment, including external billing/message-state reconciliation and deletion considerations.

tasks.title: Add redacted structured logs, error monitoring and metrics for availability, latency, queue age, webhook failures, handoffs, AI quality and spending.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Deliberately triggered failures reach the named alert recipient.

tasks.title: Write and exercise runbooks for AI outage, store disconnection, stalled jobs, suspected breach, usage spike, failed payment, recovery and offboarding.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: A designated operator can execute recovery procedures without undocumented original-author knowledge.

tasks.title: Run unit/integration/browser tests, real-database tenant tests, adversarial AI checks and load/failure tests at declared expected usage.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Attach commands, logs, results, environment and commit SHA; do not treat unit tests or mocks as live integration verification.

tasks.title: Run merchant and shopper acceptance journeys end to end, fix blockers, document support coverage and sign off on the advertised launch scope.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Merchant setup, live inquiry, verified order support, human takeover, subscription changes and export/offboarding are demonstrated.

tasks.title: Schedule ongoing dependency/security updates, integration renewals, backup checks, evaluation review, spend review and incident ownership.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Named owners, repeatable procedures and first review dates are documented; production readiness is maintained after launch.

tasks.title: Configure the appropriate Meta app/business assets, merchant onboarding/number authorization, webhook binding and required platform access/approvals.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Real authorized inbound and outbound messages map to the correct merchant.

tasks.title: Implement applicable consent/opt-out handling, service-window rules, approved templates, human escalation and delivery-status/retry handling.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Window transitions, opt-outs, template failures, duplicate events and human takeover are exercised on the real channel.

tasks.title: Track messaging charges/allowances, account restrictions and operational escalation separately from model usage.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Spend reconciliation and restriction alerts work before charging merchants for this channel.
